measurementInterpretation: Local native database, not hosted latency or billing
25 publication-barrier calls measured separately from 3005 bulk fixture inserts
1 MiB artifact measures verified I/O only, not calibrated inference
Ten-game view has unqualified values and is not a qualified full-population payload benchmark
Real model size, final scope, full-scale browser, remote storage pricing and v1/RSO reservations remain unmeasured
nodeResourceUsage covers the Node driver, not PostgreSQL child CPU/memory or host-wide load.
History read timings are warm local page timings; no cold-cache or network inference.
Database relation bytes include local table/index storage at this row count; no extrapolated hosted cost or saving.

remainingMeasurements.needed: Approved model/training/calibration hashes and full-universe opportunity manifest
remainingMeasurements.method: One isolated local daily pass and one maximum permitted material event, fixed population; instrument complete elapsed time, model input/serialization sizes, per-process CPU/RSS and actual artifact bytes. No provider reads.
remainingMeasurements.stop: Owner-approved CPU/memory/wall/storage caps; preserve all missed jobs.

remainingMeasurements.needed: Measured durable queue bounds, exact partitioning and concurrency reservation
remainingMeasurements.method: Use same admitted queue snapshots and deterministic interruption points; measure bounded repeated batch recovery, receipt reads and event rows. Exercise prepared-batch recovery max100 jobs per scan; never infer12000-scope fixture planner timing proves one production batch can process12000 jobs.
remainingMeasurements.stop: Any unbounded queue scan, duplicate publication, false gap or reservation conflict.

remainingMeasurements.needed: Representative qualified synthetic DTO shape from frozen real model/scope, never live user data; exact archive/history profile counts
remainingMeasurements.method: Measure max allowed10games and200history rows per response with full category/FP interval/accountability detail; desktop1440 and phone390. Keep existing keyboard/scoring invariants; record p50/p95 only over prespecified repeat count and distinguish warm/cold.
remainingMeasurements.stop: 2MiB response bound, overflow, mismatched context/profile, invalid qualification projection.

remainingMeasurements.needed: Real per-vintage model/joint/calibration bytes, deduplication manifest and storage-owner approved archive policy/pricing
remainingMeasurements.method: Record actual row/index/manifest/content sizes, artifact hash deduplication, backup/replica overhead, monotonic growth and verified restore at approved volume. Retention never expires scientific history.
remainingMeasurements.stop: Stop admission at approved byte ceiling; do not delete old artifacts.

remainingMeasurements.needed: Named operations owner, existing v1/RSO CPU/memory/request reservation, environment/project, current price evidence and currency cap
remainingMeasurements.method: Owner signs exact sustainable caps after local representative measurements; read-only hosted metadata only under appropriate authority. No load test/deployment implied.
remainingMeasurements.stop: Unknown cost/reservation or any overlap with existing production budgets.

packetFieldsStillRequired: exact UTC observation window and IDs
maximum total attempts and batch/queue partitioning
permanent archive retention owner and cost budget
